title: Nondegeneracy of the finite-field trace pairing
statement: In the finite-field setting of [def-fd-additive-character], let $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ have characteristic $p$, and regard $\mathbf F_p$ as its prime subfield. The bilinear pairing $k_0\times k_0\to\mathbf F_p$, $(a,b)\mapsto\operatorname{Tr}_{k_0/\mathbf F_p}(ab)$, is nondegenerate: for every $a\ne0$ there is $b$ with $\operatorname{Tr}_{k_0/\mathbf F_p}(ab)\ne0$.

source.place: (0.2), p. 135: every additive character of $\mathbf F_q$ is obtained from the trace character; nondegeneracy of the trace pairing
